name: h4x0r
author: johnsideserf
description: Bar button and popout that spins up a 12-pane 90s hacker-movie workspace in herdr, tmux or zellij, in your Omarchy theme's colours.

barWidget.description: Engage or tear down the hacker-movie workspace, pick the multiplexer, toggle the music.

schema.label: Multiplexer
schema.description: Which terminal multiplexer to build the workspace in. auto prefers herdr when its server is reachable, then tmux.

schema.label: Layout
schema.description: auto picks a layout that fits the window; grid is the full 12-pane arrangement, cinema is 5 large panes, minimal is 3.

schema.label: Palette
schema.description: theme follows your current Omarchy colors everywhere, including the pane programs. The rest are fixed CRT palettes: phosphor green, amber, ice blue, crimson, synthwave, and mono.

schema.label: Start cliamp
schema.description: Give the bottom strip a cliamp visualiser. Skipped automatically when cliamp is already playing elsewhere.
